per_survivor.name: Coppice-GA
per_survivor.reason: Tenure trigger novel but reactive & thin: by the time it fires, dominant primitives have propagated through offspring via crossover; benching one genome doesn't restore diversity; niching/island methods do more.

per_survivor.name: Adaptive-Fenwick
per_survivor.closest: Adaptive Memory Decay for Log-Linear Attention (2605.06946)
per_survivor.reason: Content-adaptive TOPOLOGY either collapses back to soft-gating over fixed buckets (~2605.06946) or forfeits the O(log T) scan/hardware efficiency; cosine-routing-paradox (2603.20997) weakens the gate. No win either way.

per_survivor.name: Kotekan Dual-Head Drafting
per_survivor.reason: Acceptance in spec-decoding is prefix-sequential -> even/odd parity gives no mechanistic gain over contiguous position-splitting (PosS) or stride-2 leap (L-MTP); depth-doubling flows from having 2 heads, not from parity.

per_survivor.name: Global Advantage Fallow
per_survivor.reason: The only novelty is the freeze CADENCE; REINFORCE++ already pools advantages globally inline; no evidence cross-minibatch drift survives that. A higher-cost scheduling variant (idles all rollout workers), against the async-RL engineering direction.

per_survivor.name: LoadTightening AutoTTS
per_survivor.closest: AutoTTS beta convention (2605.08083); CPO dual-monotonicity (2604.14853); budget-forcing (s1)
per_survivor.differentiator: A provable WITHIN-EPISODE monotonicity invariant on stop/prune thresholds (non-decreasing in accumulated compute), formally verified at SYNTHESIS time — orthogonal to AutoTTS's cross-episode beta convention, distinct from a static budget ceiling and from dual-variable monotonicity proofs. Both checkers med confidence; honest caveat: practical delta over beta is an open empirical question.
